journey.title: Earn to redeem — the core loop
journey.purpose: The loop the whole scenario exists to serve: work is recorded, a balance grows for a reason the holder can see, and the balance becomes something received.

steps.intent: The minter records that a chore was done, or a connected adapter reports it automatically.
The holder opens their view and sees a larger balance with the reason it grew.
The holder browses what their tokens buy and can tell what is affordable before touching anything.
The holder redeems something that needs approval and understands plainly that it is waiting on a grown-up.
The minter sees the request with enough context to decide without navigating away.
The minter approves, and the reservation settles into a debit exactly once.
The holder sees the completed redemption in their own history and can reconstruct the whole loop.

claims.statement: At every step of the loop the holder can answer why their balance is what it is.
The holder is never led to believe a queued redemption has completed.
